rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a building or place where manufacturing takes place.

example.english: This factory mainly manufactures electronic components.
example.traditional: 呢間工廠主要製造電子零件。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 zyu2 jiu3 zai3 zou6 din6 zi2 ling4 gin6

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the context already makes it clear that the place is a factory or industrial plant.

example.english: I’ll wait for you at the factory gate.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 cong2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5
